"# Implementation Plan - Offline Items Management & Sync

Support offline-first menu items management in the POS application: caching items to local PC (localStorage) when online, loading from cache when offline, queuing offline edits/creations/deletions, and syncing them to the backoffice once internet connectivity is restored.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - Unsynced offline items will be assigned a temporary local ID starting with `L-` (e.g., `L-1716492348572`). These IDs will be updated to final database-generated IDs once synced to the backoffice.
> - A **"Sync Items"** button will be displayed next to the "Add Item" button in the Items Management view if there are any pending offline changes.
> - Deleting an item while offline will queue its deletion locally and hide it from the UI immediately. When syncing, it will send the delete request to the backoffice.

## Proposed Changes

### POS Application

#### [MODIFY] [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/pos-app/src/App.jsx)

1. **State Initialization & Cache Fallback**:
   - Add state variable `unsyncedItemChanges` to track items created/edited offline.
   - Update `initApp()` to save `catalog`, `tables`, `taxes`, `paymentModes`, `discounts`, and `additionalCharges` to `localStorage` when successfully fetched.
   - Add `try-catch` blocks inside `initApp()` for each network request so that if they fail (e.g., offline), the app falls back to loading data from `localStorage` (`pos_catalog_cache`, `pos_tables_cache`, etc.).
   
2. **Items Management Offline Handlers**:
   - Update the configuration view's item loading function (triggered when opening Items Management) to cache fetched items and categories, and fall back to the cache if the API fails.
